commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Pre-commit hook that runs mypy type checking on Python files in src/

# Exit on error
set -e

echo "Running mypy type checking on src/..."

# Find all Python files in src/ and run mypy
mypy src/

# If mypy exits with non-zero, block the commit
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "mypy type checking failed. Please fix the type errors before committing."
    exit 1
fi

echo "mypy type checking passed!"
EOF
